strings.name: Robert De Niro
strings.summary: Trained in New York, De Niro developed a long collaboration with Scorsese, exploring alienation, violence and identity in Taxi Driver and Raging Bull. He won supporting and leading acting Oscars for The Godfather Part II and Raging Bull respectively. He also directs, produces and performs comedy, co-founded Tribeca in 2002 and received Cannes’ honorary Palme in 2025.
